title: Bee Removal in Great Neck, NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in Great Neck, Long Island. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote.
intro: When wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, or carpenter bees establish nests around your Great Neck property, you need fast removal from licensed professionals. The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert stinging insect nest treatment and removal throughout Great Neck — protecting your family, pets, and neighbors from aggressive defenders and repeat stinging. Our experienced technicians locate the nest, treat it directly, remove accessible material, and seal every entry point to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Great Neck homeowners and businesses for years with reliable, same-day bee removal services. Our licensed technicians understand the unique challenges of Long Island properties and provide guaranteed results at competitive rates of $350-$550.
localContext: Great Neck's beautiful tree-lined streets, historic estates, and waterfront properties near Kings Point and Saddle Rock provide ideal nesting sites for wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, and carpenter bees. From the grand homes along Middle Neck Road to the bustling Village Green area, our team responds quickly to protect Great Neck residents from stinging insect nests in attics, eaves, wall voids, soffits, chimneys, wooden trim, and the ground. Older wood-sided homes attract carpenter bees; mature trees and landscaping draw paper wasps and bald-faced hornets; ground-nesting yellow jackets colonize lawns and garden beds throughout the spring and summer months.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Great Neck?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Great Neck home?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout Great Neck and surrounding Long Island communities. Our team typically arrives within 2–4 hours for emergency situations and can treat and remove most nests in a single visit.

faqs.question: What's included in the nest removal service?
faqs.answer: Our service includes a thorough inspection to identify the species and locate the nest entrance, direct treatment of the nest through the entry point, removal of accessible nest material, sealing of entry points to prevent recolonization, and cleanup of paper nest debris. Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: What kind of products do you use?
faqs.answer: We use EPA-registered products in targeted application directly at the nest entrance and inside nesting galleries. We explain the products used and re-entry timing on every job to keep your family and pets safe.
